name: Single-mode fiber trunk
summary: MPO single-mode fiber run between optics; the transceivers carry the power.

reachM.note: Limited by the attached 800G DR optics (500 m), not by the fiber.

powerWPerEnd.note: Passive glass draws no power; optic.800g carries the transceiver power at each end.

capexUsdPerM.note: Judgment for MPO-12/16 single-mode trunk cable with connectors amortized over a typical 20–50 m run.
